attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own newsletter post, written in the first person and endorsed. He is not quoting anyone.

semantics.note: The draft keeps the antecedent and the 'which I believe it will' aside, so it is faithful. The aside does commit him to the antecedent too, but that antecedent is a metaphor. The consequent says 'will' with no deadline and does not define 'serious pressure'.

contract.note: The contract fairly finds no test. Whether the 'albatross' antecedent holds, and what counts as 'serious pressure', would both need a measure Zitron never gave. There is also no horizon.

output.rationale: This is a conditional forecast. Its antecedent, generative AI becoming an 'albatross', is a figure of speech with no test, so we cannot know whether it happened. Its consequent, 'serious pressure to curtail' spending, has no measure and no deadline. The policy says a conditional with an unknown antecedent is not scored. The evidence packet is empty, and it rightly notes that no test exists for evidence to meet. This is not a broken case, so no abstention.
